---
title: "Sea Slug Collection Summary"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## Start

```{r}
library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr) 

sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1J1mNN9AuM_pgOjtTf5w8CjcYtxe4E1Bx4cveOU6slIU"
ouvea_sheets <- sheet_names(sheet_url)

ouvea_data <- lapply(ouvea_sheets, function(sheet) {
  read_sheet(sheet_url, sheet = sheet) |>  mutate(date_sheet = sheet)
}) |>  bind_rows()

ouvea_data <- ouvea_data |> 
  mutate(date_collected = as.Date(date))

ouvea_data <- ouvea_data |> mutate(collection_method = case_when(
    tolower(collection_method) %in% c("dive", "diving") ~ "dive",
    tolower(collection_method) %in% c("snorkel", "snorkeling", "snrokel", "Snrokel") ~ "snorkel",
    is.na(collection_method) | str_trim(collection_method) == "" ~ "not recorded",
    TRUE ~ collection_method  # keep other values as-is
))

ouvea_data <- ouvea_data |> mutate(genus_species = genus_species |> 
  str_trim() |>  # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
  str_squish() |>  # Collapse multiple spaces into one
  str_replace_all("_", " ") |>  # Replace underscores with spaces
  str_replace_all("sp\\.?\\s*", "sp. ") |>  # Normalize "sp", "sp ", "sp.1"
  str_replace_all("cf\\.?\\s*", "cf. ") |>  # Normalize "cf", "cf ", etc.
  str_replace_all("aff\\.?\\s*", "aff. ") |>  # Normalize "aff", "aff "
  str_remove_all("[[:punct:]]$") |>  # Remove trailing punctuation (e.g., a final ".")
  str_to_lower() |>  # Make everything lowercase
  str_to_sentence() ) # Capitalize only the first letter
                                     
                            
specimens_per_day <- ouvea_data |> group_by(collection_method) |>   count(date_collected)
species_per_day <- ouvea_data |> 
  group_by(date_collected, collection_method) |> 
  summarise(unique_species = n_distinct(genus_species))

ouvea_data <- ouvea_data |>  arrange(date_collected)
ouvea_data <- ouvea_data |>  mutate(new_species = !duplicated(genus_species))
new_species_daily <- ouvea_data |> 
  group_by(date_collected, collection_method) |> 
  summarise(new_species = sum(new_species)) 
```

Main summarizing functions

```{r}
ggplot(specimens_per_day, aes(x = date_collected, y = n, 
                              fill =collection_method,
                              )) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Specimens Collected Per Day", 
       x= "Date Collected", 
       y= "Count",
       fill="Collection Method")+
  geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5))+
scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 day",    # show a tick for each date
    date_labels = "%e %b"     # format like "6 Jan", "7 Jan"
)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggplot(species_per_day, aes(x = date_collected, 
                            y = unique_species, 
                            fill=collection_method)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Species Per Day", 
       x= "Date Collected", 
       y= "Count",
       fill= "Collection Method")+
  geom_text(aes(label = unique_species), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5))+
scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 day",    # show a tick for each date
    date_labels = "%e %b"     # format like "6 Jan", "7 Jan"
)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))



new_species_daily <- new_species_daily |> 
  mutate(vjust_pos = ifelse(collection_method == "snorkel", -2, 2))  
  # Above for snorkel, below for dive

ggplot(new_species_daily, aes(x = date_collected, 
                              y = new_species,
                              color= collection_method)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()+
 geom_segment(aes(x = date_collected, y = new_species, 
                   xend = date_collected, yend = new_species + vjust_pos), 
               linetype = "solid", color = "black") +  # Adjust the direction of the line
  geom_text(aes(label = new_species ,vjust = vjust_pos), size = 3)+
  labs(title = "New Species Per Day",
     x= "Date Collected", 
       y= "Count",
       color="Collection Method")+
scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 day",    # show a tick for each date
    date_labels = "%e %b"     # format like "6 Jan", "7 Jan"
)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


ggplot(new_species_daily, aes(x = date_collected, 
                              y = new_species,
                              color = collection_method)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  # Line to labels: Ensure correct direction of line to label
  geom_curve(aes(x = date_collected, y = new_species, 
                   xend = date_collected, yend = new_species + vjust_pos), 
               linetype = "solid", color = "black", curvature = 0.1, alpha =0.6) +  
  # Adjust label position using vjust (but for placement, not alignment)
  geom_text(aes(label = new_species, y = new_species + vjust_pos), size = 3) +  
  labs(title = "New Species Per Day",
       x = "Date Collected", 
       y = "Count",
       color = "Collection Method") +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 day",    # Show a tick for each date
    date_labels = "%e %b"     # Format like "6 Jan", "7 Jan"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
